column10: Food.com has the strongest combined Role A support: explicit user-recipe interactions, dates, recipe titles, rich tags/ingredients/techniques, official split artifacts, manageable scale, and strong later calibration support. Steam is the backup because it is also strong but requires more review/recommendation-signal adaptation.
column11: No E3 acquisition, no preprocessing, no training, no LLM inference, no dataset download.
